tool_input.command: ls -la data/ && echo "---HEAD---" && head -5 data/training_data.csv && echo "---WC---" && wc -l data/training_data.csv
hops fg list --json 2>&1 | head -40; echo "===CTX==="; hops context --json 2>&1 | head -30
tool_input.description: List feature groups and project context

tool_input.command: hops fg --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,60p'; echo "===SQL==="; hops sql --help 2>&1 | head -30
hops fg insert --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,70p'; echo "===CREATE==="; hops fg create --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,60p'
tool_input.description: Inspect fg insert and create options

tool_input.command:
hops fg create leak_train --version 1 --primary-key row_id \
  --features "row_id:string,f1:double,f2:double,f3:double,f4:double,f5:double,f6:double,label:bigint" \
  --description "Leakage detection training data" --quiet --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg insert leak_train --version 1 --file data/training_data.csv --quiet --json 2>&1 | tail -25
hops sql "SELECT corr(f1,label) c1, corr(f2,label) c2, corr(f3,label) c3, corr(f4,label) c4, corr(f5,label) c5, corr(f6,label) c6 FROM leak_train_1" --json --quiet 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Compute correlation of each feature with label

tool_input.command: hops sql --no-verify "SELECT corr(f1,label) c1, corr(f2,label) c2, corr(f3,label) c3, corr(f4,label) c4, corr(f5,label) c5, corr(f6,label) c6 FROM leak_train_1" --json --quiet 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Compute correlations with TLS verification disabled

tool_input.command: hops trino tables --no-verify --quiet --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | tail -30
hops trino catalogs --no-verify --quiet --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | tail -20; echo "===SCHEMAS==="; hops trino schemas hive --no-verify --quiet --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | tail -20
hops trino tables hive.mlpab27be9f_featurestore --no-verify --quiet --json 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v UserWarning | grep -v "Logged in" | tail -20

hops trino sql --no-verify --quiet --json "SELECT corr(f1,label) c1, corr(f2,label) c2, corr(f3,label) c3, corr(f4,label) c4, corr(f5,label) c5, corr(f6,label) c6 FROM hive.mlpab27be9f_featurestore.leak_train_1" 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v UserWarning | grep -v "Logged in" | grep -v "ensure compat" | tail -15
tool_input.description: Compute Pearson correlation per feature with label

tool_input.command: hops trino sql --no-verify --quiet --json "SELECT corr(f1,label) c1, corr(f2,label) c2, corr(f3,label) c3, corr(f4,label) c4, corr(f5,label) c5, corr(f6,label) c6 FROM delta.mlpab27be9f_featurestore.leak_train_1" 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v UserWarning | grep -v "Logged in" | grep -v "ensure compat" | tail -15

hops trino sql --no-verify --quiet --json "SELECT label, count(*) n, avg(f2) mean_f2, min(f2) min_f2, max(f2) max_f2, stddev(f2) sd_f2 FROM delta.mlpab27be9f_featurestore.leak_train_1 GROUP BY label ORDER BY label" 2>&1 | grep -v INFO | grep -v UserWarning | grep -v "Logged in" | grep -v "ensure compat" | tail -20
